name: @youproof.org/display-templates
description: The reference display template engine: the expression language, the template checks, list resolution, the template collection reader, the references list reader, the inline token grammar with its entity decoding and sentence-start rule, and the template context and resolution of a file's references over the content outline. Plain TypeScript source with no third-party runtime dependencies (it uses the sibling @youproof.org/content-model), consumed from source by the website, and meant to be bundled by the editor.
